anya: Quick share — I ran a regional suite comparing scheduler tiling profiles + fair-share heuristics. Posting the highlights, pinging @carlos @linh for deeper analysis.

perf-bot: results CSV (abridged):
```
Region | GPU  | config                                         | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | max_throughput(req/s) | avg_batch_tokens
us-east | H100 | tile=128,window=20,max_tokens=1024,fair=true  | 18      | 120     | 220                   | 230
eu-west | H100 | tile=128,window=20,max_tokens=1024,fair=true  | 22      | 150     | 200                   | 210
ap-south| A100 | tile=64,window=30,max_tokens=768,fair=false    | 35      | 260     | 140                   | 190
```

carlos: Quick notes — fair=true seems to shave tails for shorter sequences on H100 (p95 improvement) but we see throughput drop on A100 when fair enabled. Tiling=128 favors H100 memory/warp patterns.

linh: Also saw KV-cache warmup spikes in ap-south during the runs, here's a snippet:
```
[03-20 10:12:03] cache-mgr WARN warmup miss seq=0.78s
[03-20 10:12:04] rpc    INFO  batch_start id=run-1812349012 size=6 tokens=420
[03-20 10:12:05] kernel WARN tile-mismatch fallback to naive path
```

mike: Suggestion — try dynamic max_tokens per request (cap to 0.9 * free_kv_slots) and narrower batch_window for A100 (10 vs 30). Also test tile=96 as middle ground.

anya: Action items: 1) Run AB on ap-south A100 window=10 vs 20 with tile=96, fair=true/false; 2) Collect per-model seqlen histogram + KV hit-rate; 3) Add int8 kernel variant in the mix. @infra-bot can you queue this? :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Scheduled job run-id=run-2026-03-20-001, started_ts=1812349120, eta_seconds=1080 (approx 18m).

perf-bot: interim numbers from window=10 (tile=96,max_tokens=768,fair=true) on ap-south A100: p50=30ms, p95=210ms, throughput approx -12% vs baseline, avg_batch_tokens=175. Tail improved but throughput hit as expected.

carlos: Good. If int8 kernels can reclaim ~15% perf we might be net neutral on throughput while keeping tails low. Also check compliance with selected quant profiles (no quality regression).

linh: I'll attach the seqlen histogram and KV hit-rate in the doc once job completes. Early view shows 60% requests <256 tokens which explains why fair helped tails.

anya: OK — we'll reconvene after run completes. Thanks all.

mike: FYI I'll spin a short micro-benchmark on my dev box for tile=96 vs 128 to validate kernel throughput deltas.

perf-bot: note: next full sweep scheduled if run-2026-03-20-001 passes smoke checks.
